data.title: Como Residences
data.about:
Welcome to Como Residences by Nakheel, where the designer vacation community meets world-class amenities to provide a unique and luxurious lifestyle. Elevate your living standards with exclusive features and conveniences that redefine your way of life. Our pinnacle of luxury living includes an array of opulent apartments perched atop a 75-storey tower. 

Indulge in the utmost care and comfort with a remarkable selection of 2- to 6 bedroom apartments and 7-bedroom duplexes that offer unmatched grandeur and luxury.

Each showstopping residence embodies refined elegance and sophistication while embracing the coastal lifestyle. Relax in your private home and experience a never-ending holiday amidst stunning surroundings and luxurious amenities, creating unforgettable moments with your loved ones.

characteristics_module.title: A Unique Tower of Vertical Lakes
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Price starting from AED 21M – 80 / 20 payment plan
  • Massively spacious apartments 5000 SQ FT+
  • Luxurious apartments situated on 75 storey tower
  • High rise apartments offering 2-5 and 4-7 Bedroom apartments
  • Resort style podium amenities
  • Located in the world’s largest man-made islands
  • Sandy beach area within its area featuring a delightful leisure attraction
  • Enjoy extraordinary views of Palm Jumeirah and the sea
  • Infinity edge swimming pool

location_tile.title: Live in the Heart of Palm Jumeirah
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Experience a life of utmost indulgence at Como Residences by Nakheel, situated in the heart of Palm Jumeirah, Dubai. Feast your eyes on the spectacular views and cutting-edge architecture that make this property stand out. Bask in the luxury of world-class amenities and top-of-the-line facilities that cater to your every whim, from exquisite gastronomy to unparalleled entertainment options. Its strategic location close to major business and entertainment hubs makes it the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and luxury that promises to redefine your lifestyle.

  • 10 minutes from Dubai Marina
  • 10 minutes from Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 15 minutes from Ain Dubai
  • 25 minutes from Dubai International Airport
